content.short: BtcTurk is Turkey's first crypto exchange, launched in 2013, for trading crypto against the Turkish lira with direct bank transfers.
content.description: BtcTurk has served Turkish users since 2013. Customers move lira in and out through local bank accounts and trade hundreds of pairs with market, limit and stop orders on web and mobile. The business runs two platforms: BtcTurk Kripto for the domestic market and BtcTurk Global for international users. It is part of a wider group offering self-service financial products in Turkey.
content.meta: Turkey's longest-running crypto exchange, with lira bank transfers and hundreds of trading pairs. Explore BtcTurk on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
